bifrost: springboard/proto/src/sys.rs (shm_create, SCM_RIGHTS), springboard/src/bare/wayland.rs (dma-buf wl_buffer), springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs (BufferInfo), springboard/src/media/mod.rs (DmaBuf trait, DmaPicture)
summary: The system layer shares buffers across processes with memfd and fd passing, and imports GPU dma-bufs with format and modifier metadata. Apps get no IOSurface-like SDK type: they receive shared memory only as internal pixel copies, with no lookup by ID, attributes, purgeability or colour space.

features.note: memfd shared memory (ashmem fallback) is created, sized and resized, and tested headless in springboard/proto/tests/parity_sdk-os-05.rs. Gap: no app-facing SDK type wraps a shared file, and it is not a texture or framebuffer.

features.feature: Passing a buffer to another process
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/buffer_handoff.rs (SharedBuffer, send_buffer, receive_buffer); springboard/proto/src/sys.rs (socketpair_pair, SCM_RIGHTS); springboard/src/shell/apphost.rs:437 (sends one descriptor)
features.note: An app sends a shared buffer as one descriptor over a connected channel, and the receiver maps the same memory; empty, oversized, descriptor-less, extra-descriptor and closed-peer cases are typed errors, tested headless in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-rest-10.rs. Gap: the shell does not yet relay a buffer between two apps, and there is no lookup by ID, so this needs Midget with two running apps.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 5 tests. Wave 4 (w4-iosurface, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. searched for dma-buf and shared buffer lookup; no ID registry was found

features.note: Stays os. The GBM buffer is allocated and exported as a dma-buf inside the shell (springboard/src/gpu/desktop.rs, Bo), and the Wayland import is made by the shell's presenter, with the formats and modifiers it advertises. Blocker for an app-facing type: the SDK has no GPU buffer allocator or import call, although the app sandbox already grants /dev/dri (springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs); the zero-copy follow-up is at docs/bifrost-ui.md:767

features.note: frames are copied into shared memory and blitted; zero-copy is the stated follow-up at docs/bifrost-ui.md:767

gaps: No app-facing SDK type for a shared buffer: apps cannot create, lock, or share an IOSurface-like object.
No global ID registry or lookup by ID between processes.
No per-buffer attributes (key-value store, colour space, ICC profile).
No use counts, in-use query, or buffer-level purgeability.
No CPU write lock API, and no selectable cache mode.
Zero-copy frames from the engine into the window pool (dma-buf from a GPU context) are not done.
